name: Zhiqiang Power - Diesel Generator Quotation & Product Information
description: Luchuan County Zhiqiang Motor Factory (Zhiqiang Power) builds factory-direct Yuchai diesel generator sets from 30 kW to 2200 kW (50/60 Hz) - open skid, silent canopy, containerised and trailer-mounted - and exports them to Vietnam, the Philippines, Thailand, Malaysia, Myanmar, Indonesia and Singapore. This card lists the services an AI agent can request: a project quotation, product specifications, and company/contact details.

skills.name: Request a diesel generator quotation
skills.description: Collect the load in kW, duty, frequency, voltage, enclosure, quantity and destination port, then submit via the request-a-quote page; a sales engineer replies with configuration, price and shipping.
examples: Quote a 250 kVA silent genset for Manila, 60 Hz
Price 5 units of 100 kW open-skid sets FOB

skills.name: Get generator set specifications
skills.description: Return specifications, fuel-consumption curves and dimensions for a model from the 30-2200 kW catalogue.
examples: Specs for the 500 kW Yuchai set
Fuel consumption of the 800 kVA prime model

skills.name: Get company contact and certification details
skills.description: Return the factory address, phone, WhatsApp, email and ISO 9001 certification.
